Dear Jeffrey,

wrote:

we have run out of funds again to pay our rent... Could I ask you for about 25K until the end of 2014, or 50K
for the period until April, please?
Thank you!
Some research is coming along, btw. I have joined a group around psychiatrist/neuro-scientist Justin Brewer
that tries to understand which parts of the brain and mind play a role for consciousness. I have got an intern
to help me with programming a user interface to our cognitive architecture, and I am thinking about building
tangible neural networks for the Media Lab, so people can play around with artificial neural networks and
understand them without having a background in computer science.
At PED, I am continuing some experiments with evolutionary simulation of nonreciprocal cooperation.
One of my current interests is in understanding music cognition. I have identified a few dimensions that
make music delectable (such as psychophysically pleasurable patterns, abstract structure discovery, trance
induction, social side effects etc.) and check into how I can model music with grammars and predictive
models. Reading Arbib's excellent new book (Music, Language and the Brain).
Marvin has sent a short message, so I assume that he is alive and that there is hope that I am going to meet
him one of these days.
Max Tegmark has invited me to a small conference with smart people on the future of AI in San Juan, early
next year, which is certainly going to be fun.
Thank you for making all of this possible!
Bests
Joscha
